dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Hey, aren't you the assistant for Xiangling, the chef from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: You couldn't possibly be here by coincidence. I've got it! She must want to challenge me again. I am "Mondstadt's Rotisseur Queen," after all.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh... That's not it, huh? Well seeing as she already beat me last time, I guess challenging me again wouldn't prove much.
